# Spartex

> > Leading manufacturer and exporter of quality pens and pencils in India, offering bulk orders and corporate gifting solutions.

Spartex is an India-based pen and pencil manufacturer based in Kolkata that specializes in producing affordable, high-quality writing instruments for bulk orders and corporate clients. The company offers a diverse product portfolio including ball pens, gel pens, sketch pens, and polymer pencils.
